archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Minecraft Dungeons II's Sift dimension is coming to Minecraft in 2027

entries.headline: Minecraft Dungeons II's Sift dimension will come to Minecraft Java and Bedrock in 2027
entries.summary: Xbox Wire reports that Mojang used Minecraft LIVE to detail The Sift, the first new Minecraft dimension in more than 14 years. It will appear first in Minecraft Dungeons II when that game launches on September 29, and Mojang also confirmed that The Sift will come to Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition in 2027.
entries.verification: The primary Xbox Wire page was opened; this copy is limited to Mojang's explicit statements about The Sift, its 2027 arrival in Minecraft, and Minecraft Dungeons II's September 29 launch.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire publication time converts to 02:00 Beijing time on September 27 and falls inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Summer Pockets Sunnyside Stories announced for PC, launches December 18
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Key announced Summer Pockets Sunnyside Stories for PC on September 26, with a December 18 release date. The project turns previously published official Summer Pockets short stories into a fully voiced visual novel and includes newly written material; the announcement also names Konomi Suzuki as the singer of the new opening theme, Luster piece.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON report was opened; the game title, PC platform, December 18 date, fully voiced short-story adaptation, and opening-theme details are explicitly attributed to Key's September 26 announcement.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON publication time converts to 20:32 Beijing time on September 26 and falls inside this edition's fixed window.
